title: Sorry about the Viper Proxy Mixin crash
excerpt: I shipped a few Viper Proxy builds with a bad Mixin target. The fixed releases are up, and I added checks to stop the same mistake happening again.

title: QuickRunLab is back, with more room to run
excerpt: I shut QuickRunLab down a while back because I couldn't justify the hosting bill. Oracle's free tier is the reason it's running again, with more compute than it ever had.

title: Porting Viperproxy to 26.x (and every version after)
excerpt: Minecraft 26.x moved the part of the client Viperproxy hooks into. Here's how I got the proxy working again, and how I'll keep it working on every version after.
